descriptionAr: About Us At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. Available Locations: Lisbon, London, Austin About the team The Zero Trust Connectivity team builds the hub that connects Cloudflare One and Zero Trust products such as Cloudflare WAN, Cloudflare One Client, Cloudflare Tunnels, Gateway and Workers VPC. Powering this hub is a set of Rust-based services operating on every one of the data-centers that Cloudflare runs. These services route all of Cloudflare One traffic end to end. By leveraging Cloudflare's incredible infrastructure and programming languages such as Rust, this critical service is safe, performant and secure. As Cloudflare Zero Trust set of features evolves, this team is responsible for evolving these hub services to deliver those new capabilities while guaranteeing scalability and reliability as top priority. We are a team of engineers who obsess over building reliable services which leverage Cloudflare's unique architecture and global network footprint. You can read more about what we work on here: https://blog.cloudflare.com/introducing-cloudflare-one/ https://blog.cloudflare.com/from-ip-packets-to-http-the-many-faces-of-our-oxy-framework/ https://blog.cloudflare.com/workers-vpc-open-beta/   About the role As a software engineer on the Zero Trust Connectivity team, you will contribute across a wide range of technologies and systems to deliver new solutions that connect Cloudflare One products together. You will build connectivity in a user-space service that can identify and route flows across our global network. This work requires close collaboration with other teams while leveraging powerful frameworks and libraries that power many Cloudflare products. Our technology stack includes Rust, Linux networking, Clickhouse, SaltStack, Prometheus, AI harnesses, and our own Cloudflare Workers platform. We're looking for determined, curious, empathetic engineers to join our team!   Desirable skills, knowledge, and experience Programming experience in Rust Familiar with Layer 3 and Layer 4 Networking Systems-level programming experience in Linux Experience building large-scale, reliable, highly distributed systems Attention to detail and ability to solve complex customer problems Own solutions end-to-end and driving the design, development, and deployment process Able to work across teams and level common, sustainable solutions Creative, open-minded, collaborative problem solver Focus on clarity in written and verbal communication Leveraging AI coding assistants to accelerate development   Compensation Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location. For Lisbon based hires: Estimated annual salary of €66,000-83,000 Equity This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.   What Makes Cloudflare Special? We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet. Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost. Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states. 1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers. Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you! Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview pro

descriptionAr: Who are we? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! Role Overview We're seeking a senior product leader to own Cohere's Inference as a Service business end to end. The product is sovereign, self-serve inference: a mid-market or enterprise buyer picks a model, a region and a GPU size, and is running the same afternoon with no procurement cycle and no infrastructure of their own. You'll decide which open-weights and first-party models we serve, in which regions and on which hardware, set the rate card they sell at, and carry the revenue and margin that follow from those calls. You own the platform around that endpoint as well, from the console and dashboards a customer administers their deployment through to the catalog of first-party and third-party models behind it. You'll set the strategy and run the execution, which means choosing where to spend across serving efficiency, the self-serve console and regional capacity when all three want the same budget, and shipping the deployment framework that removes infrastructure barriers while holding the line on data residency, compliance and operational confidence. You'll do that across engineering, serving, finance, legal and GTM without formal authority over most of it, and you'll be accountable for the outcome rather than for the roadmap. The timing is most of the opportunity. Every serious company is deciding where its models will run and what it costs to keep them running, serving demand is climbing faster than anyone can rack hardware for it, and very few of those buyers are willing to hand their data to an operator who can read it. We are starting this business from a standing start, with the models, the silicon and the encryption already in place and almost no one else able to offer the combination. You would be taking a product to market in the window where that advantage is still ours, building one of Cohere's major revenue lines from its first customer onward, and shaping how a generation of companies buys AI it can actually trust. Responsibilities Own the P&L for Inference as a Service: carry the revenue number, set the rate card, and keep blended margin above the floor as the catalog and the fleet grow. Own the inference platform itself: the console and dashboards where customers see usage, spend, API keys, access control and attestation, and the value-add tooling that makes a managed endpoint worth more than a raw one. Own the model inventory across first-party and third-party models: what enters the catalog, how it is grouped by provenance, what it is priced at, and when something is quantised, replaced or retired. Set the roadmap and the investment case across serving efficiency, the self-serve surface and regional capacity, and make the call when those three compete for the same budget. Build the commercial motion with GTM from the ground up: self-serve acquisition for the mid-market, a sales-led motion for enterprise, and the partnerships that monetise capacity we would otherwise leave idle. Stay close to the market: talk to customers and developers about integration friction and unmet needs, track competitor pricing, catalogs and launches, and follow where models and hardware are heading, then turn that into a clear view of where we should place our bets and what it would take to win. Define the metrics that tell us whether this is a business, including revenue, margin, win rate, time to first token and self-serve share, and lead the work that moves them. Partner with engineering, research, legal, finance, technical writing and developer relations to ship the platform and clear the licensing, pricing and capacity decisions behind it. Represent the business to the executive team with a recommendation, the evidence behind it and the trade-off it implies. Requirements 10+ years of product management experience, including meaningful time owning a B2B infrastructure or platform product at the scope of a business rather than a feature area. Experience operating in a GM-like capacity: you have carried a revenue line or a P&L, set pricing, and been held to margin as well as to shipping. Background at a neocloud such as Together AI, Baseten or Fireworks, or at a hyperscaler such as AWS, Azure, OCI or Google Cloud, with a working view of how inference capacity is priced, packaged and sold, and a point of view on where the segment goes next. A track record of thinking about infrastructure as a product, with the ability to translate system-level capabilities into clearly differentiated, customer-facing features. Entrepreneurial, with experience taking a new product to market and building the commercial motion around it rather than inheriting one. Experience with deployment models such as multi-tenant and dedicated infrastructure, and ownership across the full product lifecycle, from problem definition through launch, iteration and eventual migration or deprecation. Analytical by default: you define success metrics before you build, instrument thoughtfully, and use data alongside qualitative feedback to make decisions. descriptionAr: Chez nous, vendre, c'est coacher à la décision. 🎯 Nous sommes convaincus de trois choses : Vous êtes là pour sincèrement aider la personne en face de vous. Sa réussite se trouve souvent en dehors de sa zone de confort. Pour obtenir des résultats différents, il faut oser faire les choses différemment. Cela implique parfois de confronter les prospects à leurs peurs, leurs contradictions ou leurs croyances limitantes. Même si c'est inconfortable. 💡 Parfois, votre rôle sera simplement de provoquer une prise de conscience et de les laisser partir. D'autres fois, il faudra aller plus loin pour les aider à regarder la réalité en face. Toujours avec la même intention : faire ce qui est le mieux pour eux. Si cette façon de voir la vente vous parle, lisez la suite. 👇 À propos de NextGenLearning 🚀 Chez NextGenLearning, nous accompagnons des personnes qui partent de zéro pour se reconvertir en Data Analyst et décrocher un emploi. Notre objectif n’est pas de faire une formation de plus, mais de développer un nouveau standard dans notre domaine. Nous avons construit un produit exceptionnel, qui permet à nos élèves d'obtenir des transformations que beaucoup pensent impossibles. Et plutôt que de vous demander de nous croire sur parole, voici quelques témoignages de nos élèves : 🎥 Barman → Data Analyst : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yTFLTspkOGc BAC+2 → Data Analyst : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jkiycuwroAo Fonctionnaire → Data Analyst (en 8 mois avec famille et boulot en // ) : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oTGsn3x391Y Marketing → Data Project Manager : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lQG_-yspImU Jonathan - Retour après avoir fait des bootcamps pendant 4 ans : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qZqLoWP1RwA Nous sommes une petite équipe de passionnés, curieux, exigeants avec nous-mêmes, qui aiment le travail bien fait et cherchent constamment à s'améliorer. Nous grandissons et aujourd’hui, nous recherchons un Closer qui souhaite construire avec nous sur le long terme. Votre mission 🤝 Nos prospects prennent une décision importante : changer de métier. Votre rôle est de comprendre leur situation, de leur apporter les connaissances et les perspectives nécessaires, et de les aider à prendre une décision éclairée. Cela demande de savoir écouter, expliquer, rassurer et parfois confronter leurs idées. Concrètement : Mener des entretiens de vente avec des prospects qualifiés. Comprendre leurs motivations, leurs freins et leurs objectifs. Présenter notre accompagnement avec pédagogie. Assurer le suivi commercial et le reporting quotidien. Respect de nos process : les leads qualifiés le sont. Participer aux trainings d’équipe pour progresser continuellement. Conditions 📋 Statut : Freelance / Indépendant Lieu : 100% télétravail, d'où vous voulez 🌎 Disponibilité : minimum 15h par semaine, dont 10h de calls commerciaux Rémunération : discutée après qualification de votre candidature. Ce qui compte pour nous, ce sont les résultats, pas les heures travaillées. Vous êtes libre de vous organiser comme vous le souhaitez. En contrepartie, nous attendons de la fiabilité : tenir vos engagements et être présent dans les moments importants. Nous voulons être les meilleurs et gagner, mais jamais au détriment de notre santé, de notre famille ou de notre vie personnelle. Le profil recherché 🌟 Amoureux de la psychologie humaine : vous aimez comprendre les gens, leurs motivations, leurs peurs et leurs comportements. Intelligence émotionnelle : vous savez écouter, faire preuve d'empathie et confronter avec bienveillance. Communication : vous vous exprimez avec clarté, précision et impact. Ouvert au feedback (essentiel) : vous aimez apprendre, remettre en question vos méthodes et progresser. Autonome et fiable : vous savez vous organiser et prendre vos responsabilités. Orienté résultats Une expérience en vente, accompagnement client ou marketing est un plus. Mais ce sont avant tout vos compétences démontrées qui nous intéressent, pas vos diplômes ou certifications. 🚀 Pourquoi rejoindre l’équipe La meilleure raison de travailler avec nous, c’est que vous aimez ce que nous faisons et vous avez envie d’en faire partie, surtout si notre mission vous inspire. Vous travaillez d’où bon vous semble. Si vous êtes performant, vous prendrez rapidement en responsabilité au sein de l’entreprise. Nous verrons ensemble comment vous propulser vers vos objectifs et aller bien plus loin que ça (du moment que vous avez l'ambition et la détermination d'avancer avec nous sur ce chemin) ! Pour postuler ✉️ Envoyez-nous votre candidature accompagnée d'une courte vidéo (2-5 minutes) dans laquelle vous présentez : Votre parcours et vos expériences commerciales. descriptionAr: Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities. With recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte's Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we're scaling rapidly and need a skilled Mobile Service Engineer to look after our growing estate from Manchester southwards. Role Overview We are seeking a hands-on and proactive Mobile Service Engineer to manage the maintenance and overall health of our car park infrastructure from Manchester southwards, ensuring that downtime on sites due to equipment failure is kept to a minimum. You'll be responsible for the ongoing maintenance of existing sites and the coordination of subcontractors to keep operations running seamlessly. The role calls for a mix of technical expertise, knowledge of CCTV/ANPR cameras and a problem-solving mindset, with regular site visits to either oversee or carry out maintenance work. Location & Travel This is a field-based role covering our southern estate, from Manchester southwards and down to the South West, including St Austell in Cornwall. The ideal candidate will be based within this area and must be able to travel regularly to sites across all of our southern locations. We also have a North equivalent of this role, so there may be the odd occasion where you're asked to cover sites further north. We're flexible on working hours where long journeys are involved, and travel time will be factored in where necessary. Key Responsibilities Equipment maintenance: Maintain ANPR cameras, Pay & Display machines, tablets, signage and other related equipment. RAMS: Ensure Risk Assessments and Method Statements (RAMS) are prepared and followed when on site. Signage & frontline maintenance: Install and replace signage and kiosk consumables as required, ensuring compliance with safety and operational standards. Issue resolution: Diagnose and resolve technical issues on site, ensuring all equipment functions optimally. Compliance & safety: Adhere to all safe working procedures and compliance guidelines, ensuring a safe and effective work environment. Site visits: Visit sites from Manchester southwards on a scheduled basis to carry out general site health checks. Proactive monitoring: Plan and execute regular site visits and maintenance schedules across the southern estate to maintain a high-quality estate. Subcontractor coordination: Coordinate subcontractors on site to ensure maintenance and project work is delivered on time. Skills & Qualifications Background in hands-on installation, ideally from companies or industries such as Sky, CCTV, BT, Field IT or IoT-related roles. (ANPR experience is beneficial but not required.) Experience working with subcontractors to ensure projects meet deadlines. Ability to work independently, making on-the-spot decisions to meet project objectives. Experience producing site documentation, such as site maps and install plans. Comfortable working alone, following installation plans and survey documents. Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to multitask and adapt to dynamic site conditions. Based within our southern area (Manchester southwards), and able to travel regularly across all of our sites, as far as St Austell in Cornwall. Full, clean UK driving licence (essential). Basic knowledge of Risk Assessments and RAMS documentation. Desirable Qualifications / Certificates Asbestos Awareness Abrasive Wheels Certification Working at Height Certification Ladder Safety Training Health & Safety Awareness C&G 2365 (Electrical Installation) CAT & Genny Training IPAF (Powered Access Equipment) What We Offer Competitive salary & benefits: Reflective of your experience and designed to support your professional growth and well-being. Company van for site travel. Company pension, sick pay and on-site parking. Flexible, home-based working: Split your time between home, our sites and our Croydon office. Why Hozah? At Hozah, you'll play a pivotal role in a purpose-driven company at the forefront of urban mobility innovation. We foster a culture of collaboration, creativity and positive impact, where your contributions help shape the future of smarter cities. If you're looking to make a real difference in transforming the future of mobility, we'd love to hear from you. Join us and be part of this exciting journey! Job Details Job type: Full-time Schedule: Monday to Friday Location: Field-based, Manchester southwards, including the South West as far as St Austell (ideally based within this area) Hozah does not offer visa sponsorship for this role; applicants must have the right to work in the UK. descriptionAr: About the team The OpenAI Startups team helps founders build and scale products with AI. We combine technical understanding, commercial judgement and startup ecosystem relationships to help customers build and grow their businesses with OpenAI. About the role You will lead a startup sales team in EMEA, helping founders and their teams build and grow with OpenAI. The role brings together early-stage customer acquisition and commercial complexity, with opportunities that require a thoughtful understanding of customer needs, technical requirements and business priorities. You will hire and develop Account Directors, set clear direction and coach the team to build trusted customer relationships and deliver sustainable growth. You will work closely with technical and commercial partners to help customers understand the value of OpenAI and make confident decisions. This role is based in London. We use a hybrid work model of three days in the office per week. In this role, you'll: Recruit, onboard and develop a strong team of Account Directors. Set clear expectations, coach customer conversations and deal strategy, and give direct, actionable feedback. Build and execute a sales strategy that wins new startup customers and supports their long-term success. Coach the team through early-stage customer acquisition and sales opportunities with complex technical and commercial requirements. Maintain a healthy pipeline and reliable forecasts, using sound judgement and a clear understanding of customer needs. Build trusted relationships with founders, technical leaders and commercial decision-makers. Help customers understand how OpenAI can support their products and business goals. Partner across technical, product, marketing and commercial teams to support customers and resolve challenges. Develop repeatable sales practices that help a growing team work effectively while maintaining a high standard of customer experience. Bring customer feedback and market insight into the business to help improve our products and how we serve startups. We're seeking experience in: Six or more years leading sales teams, including hiring, developing and managing technical sellers in fast-changing markets. Working closely with startups as a founder, early employee or commercial leader serving startup customers. Selling platform or software products in a product-led or consumption-based business, with a record of converting technical adoption into revenue. Leading early-stage customer acquisition or complex commercial sales, with the judgement to adapt to different customer needs and buying processes. Building repeatable sales processes while maintaining a strong focus on customer fit and value. Coaching technical and commercial discovery, qualifying opportunities and managing evidence-based forecasts. Discussing AI applications and APIs credibly with founders and technical leaders, and connecting technical capabilities to business value. Working across technical, product, marketing, operational and commercial teams, and translating customer learning into better products and programmes. You'll thrive here if You understand founder urgency, earn trust through useful advice and communicate candidly about what is possible. You create clarity when priorities change, are curious about AI and learn quickly. You enjoy developing sellers and building a collaborative team that delivers for customers. What success looks like: Your team builds strong customer relationships, wins new startup business and helps customers achieve lasting value with OpenAI. Sellers grow in capability and confidence, commercial judgement is strong, and the team delivers reliable results as the business grows. descriptionAr: About the Team The AI Deployment Manager (ADM) team enables organizations to turn OpenAI products into real, sustained impact through world-class enablement and training execution. Our mission is to help customers successfully adopt and operationalize AI across their organizations. We partner with enterprises to translate the potential of OpenAI’s technology into durable capability—through structured training, technical enablement, and scalable deployment programs. By helping customers move from experimentation to production, the ADM team accelerates time-to-value, deepens meaningful adoption, and helps make OpenAI indispensable to how organizations work. About the Role The AI Deployment Manager, Builder role is a specialist post-sales technical enablement role focused on delivering high-impact enablement and adoption services across OpenAI’s product suite. You will design and deliver technical learning experiences covering OpenAI APIs, Codex, agents, evaluations, and related platform capabilities. You will work with engineers, AI and platform teams, administrators, security stakeholders, product leaders, and executive sponsors. This role blends deep technical fluency, instructional design, and customer advisory. You will lead live trainings, workshops, and adoption interventions for audiences ranging from hands-on builders to executive leaders, helping customers understand not just what OpenAI’s products can do, but how to use them effectively in real-world contexts. Success in this role means accelerating customer confidence, increasing product adoption, helping customers progress toward production use, and turning lessons from individual engagements into resources and practices that benefit many customers. This role is based in Singapore. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees In this role, you will: Own the technical enablement of OpenAI products, including OpenAI APIs, Codex, Agents, Evaluations and other platform capabilities, helping define effective enablement patterns that support adoption across customer segments Lead customer training and enablement across the full customer lifecycle, from initial onboarding through expansion, optimization, and long-term adoption. Design and deliver high-impact training engagements, including onboarding sessions, advanced capability trainings, executive briefings, hackathons, and hands-on workshops for audiences ranging from senior leaders to working teams. Drive customer activation, sustained usage, and measurable business value through structured enablement and deployment programs designed for durable adoption at scale Partner closely with Sales, Solutions Architecture, and Product teams to define an effective enablement plan tailored to each customer’s use case, goals, and technical needs. Partner closely with Sales, Solution Architects, Delivery Leads to drive adoption across our core product suite. Develop and refine reusable training assets, playbooks, and best practices based on patterns observed across customers and regions. Gather customer feedback from training and enablement engagements, synthesize themes across accounts, and relay insights to internal stakeholders to inform product and program improvements. Serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for designated product areas, building deep expertise, supporting internal enablement, identifying emerging customer use cases for new product surfaces, and aggregating customer feedback to inform product development. You’ll thrive in this role if you: Have 4+ years of experience in customer-facing or instructional roles, engaging C-level and senior technical audiences in complex enterprise environments. (preferred) or React. Experience owning technical direction for a product area, including proposing, discussing, and driving thorough, iterative solutions. A focus on safe, incremental delivery given the revenue and customer impact of this work. An overview of this role Support Engineering at GitLab believes that healthy teams deliver a healthy customer experience, and that command during a crisis shouldn't fall to whoever happens to be senior and available. GitLab's global Incident & Escalation Management (IM/EM) function coordinates critical incidents, complex multi-team engagements, and executive-level escalations for enterprise customers. As Escalation Manager, you'll own complex, executive, and commercial escalations where customer trust and the relationship are at stake, alongside or independently of a technical issue. In this functional role, you'll advocate for customers inside GitLab, coordinate teams toward resolution, and lead relationship repair after the event. What you'll do Own complex, executive, and commercial escalations end-to-end, as defined in GitLab's IM/EM engagement model. Advocate for customers internally and coordinate Engineering, Support, Product, Customer Success, and Sales toward resolution, tracking commitments and holding owning teams accountable to agreed dates and deliverables. Maintain a written, customer-facing resolution plan from engagement through confirmed resolution, updating it at each communication milestone. Coordinate with Incident Managers during concurrent technical incidents to maintain a single, coherent narrative for the customer. Own external escalation communications using GitLab's approved templates and cadence, and represent GitLab in high-stakes customer conversations where clarity and ownership influence retention. Engage Sales, Customer Success, and executive stakeholders as needed, including executive-to-executive communication for Severity 1 and 2 events. Brief GitLab leadership with concise summaries that distinguish what's known, what's unknown, and next steps. Lead post-escalation reviews and relationship repair plans, contribute corrective actions with named owners and due dates to postmortems, and hand the relationship back to the account's Customer Success Manager at resolution. Partner with the Head of IM/EM to develop playbooks, communication templates, and process improvements based on patterns from escalations. What you'll bring Experience in enterprise technical support, customer success, or incident and escalation management at a business-to-business software-as-a-service or enterprise software company. A track record of owning complex, multi-stakeholder escalations end-to-end, including executive customer engagements and structured resolution or account plans. Executive-level written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical detail into plain-language updates for customers and GitLab leadership. The ability to coordinate Engineering, Support, Product, Customer Success, and Sales under pressure without formal authority over those teams. Calm, structured decision-making with incomplete information and the ability to provide a steadying presence in high-stress customer situations. Proficiency with support and coordination tools such as Zendesk, Salesforce, Slack, and PagerDuty, or equivalent platforms. Availability for on-call coverage supporting executive escalations as part of a globally distributed team. Nice to have:  Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) Foundation or equivalent certification; customer-facing experience with GitLab, development, security, and operations (DevSecOps), continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), or cloud-native products; experience with formal escalation or incident command frameworks; or AI-assisted support tools for triage, sentiment analysis, or resolution drafting. About the team The Incident & Escalation Management function sits within Support Engineering in GitLab's Enterprise Technology & AI (ETA) division. We operate a follow-the-sun model anchored in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East and Africa, and Asia-Pacific, providing year-round, 24-hour coverage for enterprise customers. Our Escalation Managers work globally rather than within a single region, partnering with Incident Managers, Communications Leads, and regional Support Engineering leadership. You'll help shape our playbooks, templates, and standards as we scale. descriptionAr: Hello! I'm Allie, Head of Support at Ashby. 👋 One of our biggest priorities is improving the systems and workflows our Support team relies on to do their best work as we grow. The implementation will build on our existing systems and workflows, alongside our Support Operations Specialist, who helps teams use our tools effectively and keeps operational data reliable. From planning through rollout, you’ll work with IT, RevOps, and Engineering to connect the system to the tools and processes around it. Getting the configuration right is only part of the work. Helping the Support team adopt new workflows matters just as much. The configuration, automations, and integrations behind our Support systems will remain yours to own and improve as our needs evolve. You’ll be the person we rely on when something breaks, doesn’t scale, or needs to be rethought entirely. Design routing logic, SLAs, escalation paths, and reporting that can handle more complexity as we grow. Develop and lead a change management plan that helps the team adopt new systems and workflows, with clear communication, thoughtful training, and structured feedback from frontline teams and Support leaders. Administer and Optimize Support Systems Serve as the long-term administrator for our Support systems, owning configuration, automations, workflow improvements, and governance, with access management handled in partnership with internal IT. Keep finding ways to reduce friction for the team and our customers. Document system architecture, admin processes, and escalation paths, and keep that documentation current. Evaluate new tools and integrations as our needs evolve, using structured demos and input from the teams affected. Pressure-test vendor promises against our requirements, recommend solutions, and hold vendors to their commitments after the contract is signed. Partner Across Support Partner with Workforce Management, QA, and Support Training to make sure our systems support capacity planning, reporting, and the technical workflows each team relies on. You’ve configured the system yourself, not just managed the project. Experience owning a support-system migration or implementation, from scoping through go-live and beyond. You can make judgment calls when requirements are unclear and see projects through without losing momentum. Vendor evaluation experience with real skepticism. You know how to build an assessment framework, pressure-test a demo, and hold vendors to commitments after the contract is signed. You understand Support workflows, including routing, SLA and priority configuration, queue management, escalation paths, and the reporting Support leaders rely on. You understand integrations, APIs, and data migration well enough to work through technical requirements with engineers. You don’t need to write the code, but you need to understand what you’re asking for and why it matters. You can spot workflow friction, anticipate what will break as we grow, and make thoughtful tradeoffs about what to fix now versus later. Experience guiding teams through system or workflow changes, with clear communication, thoughtful training, and structured feedback from frontline teams and senior stakeholders. You know that a successful rollout depends on how people use the system, not just whether it works. You can build strong working relationships with Workforce Management, QA, Engineering, and Support Leadership. You’re comfortable explaining technical decisions to frontline team members and making the business case to senior stakeholders. You Should Apply If: You’ve worked directly inside a support ticketing system and personally owned a system migration or implementation. You know where these projects go sideways and how to keep them on track. You want to own what you build, including ongoing administration, documentation, and improvement. You’ve questioned vendor promises and know how to get past a polished demo to understand what a product can actually deliver. You move comfortably between the bigger picture and the details. You can present a vendor recommendation to leadership in the morning and dig into workflow configuration in the afternoon. descriptionAr: About the Team Research Compute Services builds the systems that help researchers use OpenAI’s compute fleet effectively. We partner with Research and Compute Infrastructure to support workloads across the compute stack, including pretraining, synthetic data generation, sampling, research inference, and reinforcement learning. Our work connects changing research needs with capacity planning, allocation, and scheduling. We build tools and services that help researchers express their compute needs, access the right resources, and run their workloads effectively. As the fleet and our research ambitions grow, we continually improve how compute is planned, allocated, and used. About the Role You will be part of an engineer-first TPM team, partnering closely with the Research Compute Services team. Your primary responsibility will be to build and own the tools, data, and platform that turn Research plans and workload signals into concrete compute demand and manage allocations across the fleet. This is a hands-on technical role. You will build alongside researchers and engineers, working directly with code and data to prototype solutions, automate workflows, and deliver tools that teams use every day. You will combine technical judgment and program leadership to connect capacity planning with the deployment, scheduling, and optimization systems that make allocated compute usable. You will work across a broad range of Research workloads, understanding their different requirements and ensuring those needs shape the platform. Success means researchers can express their needs, understand their allocations, and use compute effectively as priorities and workloads change. In this role, you will: Build with Research. Work directly with researchers across pretraining, research inference, and other workloads. Treat these communities as core users, and translate their needs into improvements across compute services, tooling, and scheduling. Own Research demand and allocation systems. Own the roadmap and delivery of the tools, data, and platform used to capture demand, support allocation decisions, and manage allocations. Carry this work from requirements and design through adoption and ongoing improvement. Turn research plans into actionable demand. Develop systems that translate evolving plans and workload requirements into concrete capacity needs, including resource requirements, timing, and constraints. Connect capacity supply and demand. Partner with Capacity Planning, Research, and infrastructure teams to reconcile demand with available supply. Build the tools and workflows needed to evaluate scenarios, manage changes, and make allocation tradeoffs visible to decision makers. Build reliable data and useful tools. Create data models, views, and automation that show what researchers need, what capacity is available, what has been allocated, and how it is being used. Improve self-service workflows for requesting and managing compute. Connect allocations to workload execution. Partner with engineers working on Kubernetes deployments and scheduling systems so allocation plans reflect workload constraints and translate into resources that researchers can use. Improve allocation and scheduling efficiency. Work with engineers to evaluate optimization approaches, including solvers operating at fleet and local scheduling levels. Help define constraints and objectives, assess tradeoffs, and measure improvements in fleet utilization. Find and address systemic gaps. Use workload and fleet data to identify bottlenecks, unused capacity, and recurring manual work. Build durable improvements to the tools and systems behind those problems. Lead technical delivery across teams. Own plans, dependencies, and decisions across Research, Research Compute Services, Capacity Planning, and infrastructure engineering. Keep teams aligned on what needs to be built, how it will be adopted, and who will operate it. Make progress and tradeoffs clear. Give working teams and leadership a clear view of demand, allocation constraints, delivery progress, and decisions that need attention. You might thrive in this role if you: Have a strong engineering foundation, developed through relevant education or demonstrated technical experience. Have led and delivered complex technical programs involving large-scale compute, distributed systems, infrastructure platforms, or research environments. Have practical experience with capacity planning, including supply and demand management, compute allocations, and the tools and data that support those decisions. Have personally built or materially contributed to tools, data systems, or automation used by engineering or research teams. You are comfortable working directly with code and operational data. Are familiar with Kubernetes deployments and scheduling systems, and understand how resource constraints and placement decisions affect workload execution. Understand optimization solvers and can reason about their use in fleet-wide allocation and local scheduling. You can evaluate constraints, objectives, and tradeoffs without losing sight of researcher needs. Can work closely with researchers to understand evolving requirements and translate them into systems that are practical to build and useful in daily work. Can take ownership of ambiguous technical problems, establish a clear path forward, and bring complex work through delivery and adoption. Communicate technical decisions, constraints, and priorities clearly across engineering, Research, and leadership. Are resourceful, comfortable with changing priorities, and motivated by improving both researcher productivity and compute efficiency. Are interested in and thoughtful about the impacts of AGI. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world

You will own the roadmap, requirements, delivery, and adoption of the tools, data, and platform behind that signal, partnering with Engineering to build systems that support planning and execution across OpenAI. You will also lead programs that turn incoming supply into usable compute. Working across cloud providers, Data Center Infrastructure, and compute engineering teams, you will connect physical site readiness with the CPU, storage, network, GPU, and foundational services required to bring new sites and clusters online. You will be part of an engineer-first TPM team, managing a broad portfolio of infrastructure programs and making dependencies, risks, and decisions clear from working teams through leadership. Your work will help teams plan with confidence, respond to supply changes, and deliver capacity on time. In this role, you will: Own the GPU supply signal across the fleet. Implement rigorous risk tiering, formal approval checkpoints, detailed audit logs, and execution lineage to ensure safe autonomous operations. Incorporate predictive statistical and machine learning models into agent systems, establishing robust BigQuery data pipelines, optimized access patterns, and continuous monitoring. Author comprehensive technical specifications and Requests for Comments (RFCs), perform peer design reviews, and establish architectural standards for AI agent deployment across the organization. Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience Senior-level software engineering experience, with security conscious production systems you can point to (repos, releases, services you operated). Strong TypeScript, and comfort building on serverless or edge runtimes (Cloudflare Workers preferred). HTTP APIs, async, queues, performance. Experience with LLMs and agents: tool calling, structured output, multi-step or multi-agent orchestration, prompt and eval iteration. Experience with durable state and workflows (Durable Objects, Cloudflare Workflows, or equivalents such as Templets updraoral or Step Functions). Demonstrated experience in infrastructure planning: capacity planning, forecasting, networking, CDN, cloud or data center capacity, or adjacent work. We will teach you our specific systems. Solid data skills: SQL, a cloud data warehouse (BigQuery preferred), and working knowledge of forecasting and statistical modeling (backtesting, error metrics, knowing when a model is wrong). Clear written communication: specs, RFCs, and explanations that planners and executives can use. Bonus Points A data science or ML background (time series, optimization, predictive modeling) and Python for scientific computing. Experience with Hono, Zod, OpenAPI, and a modern frontend framework (Astro or React). Experience with peering, BGP, ASN and IX data, backbone or transit planning, or colo, power, and procurement planning. Experience with agent frameworks (LangGraph, Autogen, A2A) and knowing what to borrow and what to discard. CI/CD and infrastructure as code (GitLab CI, Terraform). Experience building LLM evaluation frameworks or human-review workflows. Bias for simple, scalable designs. Compensation Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location. For Portugal-based hires: Estimated annual salary of €66,000-€91,000 Equity This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.  Available Locations: Austin, New York, San Francisco, Remote About the Team We manage an internal, multi-region PostgreSQL platform that enables engineers to rapidly build, deploy, and operate services. Our mission is to provide a highly available, stable, and self-service platform with clear operational visibility. As a Systems Engineer, you will collaborate with database engineers, developers, and infrastructure teams to evolve our database architecture and automation. You will be instrumental in scaling our PostgreSQL infrastructure and enhancing database reliability. If you are passionate about PostgreSQL, automation, reliability, and database tooling, let's connect! Role Responsibilities Build, deploy, and manage PostgreSQL database clusters in production environments.  Develop and maintain database tooling for automation, monitoring and performance tuning. Implement high availability, backup and disaster recovery solutions.  Work closely with Infrastructure and Applications teams to integrate database tools.  Implement proactive solutions using observability tools to monitor database health.  Optimize database performance, indexing strategies, and query tuning.  Role Requirements (Must-Have Skills) Must-Have Skills Experience with building, scaling, and managing large-scale multi-tenant PostgreSQL database clusters, encompassing high availability failover, and disaster recovery strategies. Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible or Salt) . Experience in scripting languages (Python, Bash) for automation.  Experience building and maintaining database tooling for automation and monitoring. Experience with containerization technologies like Docker and Kubernetes. Experience optimizing database performance and query tuning. Experience with alerting and monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and Kibana. Nice-to-Have Skills Experience developing software in Go, Ruby or C/C++ Contributions to PostgreSQL or relevant open-source projects. Expertise in database schema migrations and automation using tools like Flyway, Liquibase or goose.  Experience with connection pooling solutions such as PgBouncer, HAProxy. Experience with non-relational data stores such as Distributed & time-series databases (ex. Cassandra, Timescale) and key-value stores (eg., Redis)  Compensation Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location. For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $157,000 - $196,000 For New York based hires: Estimated annual salary of $150,000 - $187,000  Equity This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan. We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet. Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost. Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration

descriptionAr: Über VIA HealthTech VIA macht aus einer Therapiesitzung ein fertiges Sitzungsprotokoll und aus Sitzungsprotokollen vollständige psychologische Berichte. Arbeit, die Therapeut:innen bisher mehrere Stunden pro Woche gekostet hat. Wir sind die marktführende KI-Assistenz für Psychotherapeut:innen. Über 4.000 Psychotherapeut:innen im DACH-Raum nutzen VIA, wir verarbeiten Hunderttausende Sitzungen pro Monat. Wir sind nach ISO 27001:2022 zertifiziert und verfügen über ein BSI-C5-Testat. Wir sind ein multidisziplinäres Team in Berlin-Mitte. Marktführer in Deutschland zu sein, ist erst der Startpunkt. Die Schweiz ist unser nächster Markt, und du baust ihn mit auf. Die Rolle Du bist unsere erste Person im Schweizer Markt. Du baust die Pipeline von Grund auf, entwickelst das Playbook und führst es selbst aus. In Deutschland läuft unser Funnel vor allem über Webinare: Therapeut:innen melden sich an, testen VIA 14 Tage und buchen selbst. Du findest heraus, was davon in der Schweiz funktioniert und was anders laufen muss: Qualifizierung am Telefon, Cold-Calling, andere Outbound- und Inbound-Kanäle, Verbände, Weiterbildungsinstitute, grössere Organisationen als eigener Kanal. Du testest, misst und skalierst, wo der Hebel am grössten ist. Du arbeitest eng mit Marketing an Zielgruppen, Kampagnen und Botschaften für den Schweizer Markt und gibst direkt zurück, was im Gespräch wirklich zieht. Die Rolle ist senior gedacht. Wenn du mid-level, aber aussergewöhnlich schnell und hungrig bist, bewirb dich trotzdem. Deine Aufgaben Den Markt öffnen. Du identifizierst die wichtigsten Zielgruppen in der Schweiz: selbstständige psychologische Psychotherapeut:innen, Psychiater:innen, Organisationen der psychologischen Psychotherapie, Ambulatorien und Kliniken. Du priorisierst, wo wir zuerst gewinnen. Leads in Kund:innen verwandeln. Qualifizierungsgespräche, Webinare, Demos, Follow-up während der Testphase, Abschluss. Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für Schweizer Kund:innen. Neue Kanäle erschliessen. Berufsverbände wie FSP, ASP und SBAP, Weiterbildungsinstitute, Fachveranstaltungen und Kongresse. Erstansprache per Telefon, E-Mail und LinkedIn, wo sie sich lohnt. Playbook bauen, während du verkaufst. Was konvertiert, welche Einwände in der Schweiz wirklich kommen (etwa zu Datenschutz und Datenhaltung), welche Sequenz funktioniert. Zahlen verantworten. Deine KPIs entlang des Funnels, gemeinsam mit unserem Commercial Engine Lead, der Tracking und Infrastruktur baut. Sales-Enablement-Material. Du passt an, was zum Verkaufen und Vermarkten in der Schweiz am besten wirkt, von Sprache bis Preisdarstellung in CHF. Feedback ins Produkt bringen. Was Schweizer Kund:innen brauchen und woran Deals scheitern, besprichst du direkt mit dem Produktteam. Dein Profil Must-have Nachgewiesene Abschlüsse im B2B-Vertrieb in der Schweiz, idealerweise SaaS oder Digital Health, belegbar in Zahlen Echte Hunter-Mentalität. Du hast bereits aktiv Erstkontakte am Telefon gemacht und hast damit kein Problem. Wenn dich 40 Gespräche am Tag abschrecken, ist das die falsche Rolle Kenntnis des Schweizer Gesundheitswesens oder die Fähigkeit, dich sehr schnell einzuarbeiten: Grundversicherung, Anordnungsmodell, Rolle von Kantonen und Verbänden Glaubwürdigkeit gegenüber Therapeut:innen. Psychotherapeut:innen vertrauen vor allem Psychotherapeut:innen. Entweder bringst du diesen Hintergrund mit, oder du arbeitest dich so schnell und so tief ein, dass man es dir im Gespräch nicht anmerkt Systemdenken. Du baust reproduzierbare Prozesse statt Einzelfälle, mit dem Ziel, dass dein Ansatz auch ohne dich funktioniert Hunger und unternehmerischer Ehrgeiz. Du willst einen neuen Markt aufbauen, nicht eine Quote abarbeiten Kommunikationsstärke mit Abschlussfokus. Empathisch und auf Augenhöhe, denn Psychotherapeut:innen merken sofort, wenn jemand verkauft, statt zu verstehen Selbstständige, strukturierte und datengetriebene Arbeitsweise, auch remote und ohne Team vor Ort, sowie sicherer Umgang mit CRM-Systemen Deutsch auf verhandlungssicherem Niveau (C2), auch Schweizerdeutsch, gutes Englisch Verfügbarkeit am frühen Abend. Unsere Zielgruppe ist häufig erst nach der letzten Sitzung erreichbar, Termine zwischen 17 und 19 Uhr gehören dazu. Im Gegenzug gestaltest du deinen Tag frei Von Vorteil Französisch und/oder Italienisch, um später auch die weiteren Gebiete anzusprechen Ein bestehendes Netzwerk in der Schweizer Psychotherapie- oder Psychiatrieszene Erfahrung mit Funnels, in denen Marketing und Vertrieb ineinandergreifen: Performance-Marketing, Webinare, Trials, Self-Service Anerkennung als Psychotherapeut:in, psychologische Ausbildung oder mehrjährige Erfahrung im Gesundheitswesen Vertriebserfahrung mit Praxen, Heilberufen oder Spitälern in der Schweiz Hands-on-Erfahrung mit Sales-Automation, LinkedIn Sales Navigator oder Outbound-Tooling Erfahrung im Markteintritt oder Aufbau eines Vertriebs von 0 auf 1 Diese Rolle ist nichts für dich, wenn Du ein Team suchst, das für dich telefoniert. Du eine fertige Pipeline oder ein bestehendes Länderteam erwartest. Du baust beides. Du weder Hunger noch besonderen Ehrgeiz mitbringst. Wir sind ein ambitioniertes Team und stellen entsprechend ein. Was wir bieten Einen Markt, den du prägst. Du bist die erste Person von VIA in der Schweiz. Was du aufbaust, wird zum Fundament unseres Schweizer Geschäfts Ein Team, das überperformt. DACH-Marktführer für KI-Assistenz in der Psychotherapie in zwei Jahren, bootstrapped. Unsere Pläne von hier sind deutlich grösser, und wir stellen Menschen ein, die das mitgestalten wollen Hohe Autonomie und Erfolgsbeteiligung. Bei uns zählen Kompetenz und Umsetzung. Wir legen dir keine Steine in den Weg, und du verdienst an dem, was du aufbaust Attraktives Paket. Wettbewerbsfähiges Fixum in CHF plus ungedeckelte Provision, dazu Beteiligung am Unternehmen Direkter Draht. Du arbeitest täglich mit den Gründern und dem multidisziplinären Team, Entscheidungen fallen in Stunden statt in Wochen Sinnstiftende Arbei

descriptionAr: Who are we? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! About the Role Cohere is in a unique and exciting position to grow our GTM team globally! We are expanding our Talent Team and are looking for a creative, high-performing go-to-market talent partner who is eager to take on a new challenge as we are in the early stages of building the Talent Acquisition function. In this role, you will master a new domain of recruiting, recruit world-class technical talent, and influence the scaling of a high-growth Canadian tech company. If you consider yourself resilient, collaborative, influential, and a lifelong learner, we’d love to hear from you! What You’ll Do As a Talent Partner for Cohere, you will: Own the full lifecycle recruitment process, attracting and recruiting top talent for GTM at Cohere. Make sure our candidates have a world-class recruiting experience with us. Work with hiring managers and leaders to create effective recruiting strategies. Keep us up-to-date with talent market and industry insights so we can make informed decisions. Keep track of recruiting funnels in Ashby our ATS, and update the progress regularly. Find creative ways to proactively source and recruit candidates to optimize the top of the funnel. Build relationships with diverse tech and talent communities. Bring in other exciting talent projects and take ownership of them! Attend and represent our Talent Acquisition team at industry conferences as well as plan and execute curated networking events. Who You Are 8+ years of go-to-market, full-cycle recruiting experience scaling high-growth teams (experience at startups is a plus). You are a creative problem solver and thrive under pressure. We are a fast-growing scale up and with that comes ambiguity and change. You are a natural influencer and enjoy working cross-functionally. You love data and take a data-driven approach to your recruiting. You are passionate about diversity, community, and ensuring an equitable recruiting process. You are naturally curious, with a keen interest in the AI industry, specifically around NLP, LLMs, and cutting-edge research in this space. Full-Time Employees at Cohere enjoy these Perks: A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. How and Where We Work: Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form , and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers page.

descriptionAr: Hi 👋 I’m Rosalia , and I look after our Product Marketing team at Ashby. I started my career in Product Marketing and helped build the Sales Enablement function at HubSpot during its journey from startup to IPO. Since then, I’ve worked across RevOps and Customer Marketing at Procore and Meta, partnering with incredible teams to bring differentiated products to market. I first heard of Ashby through our Head of Content, Anum with whom I’d spent those early days at HubSpot, and was inspired by the level of thoughtfulness and operating principles I saw and read about. I joined Ashby in April of 2024 back in Product Marketing - bringing all these experiences together to help build a thoughtful, high-impact team. We’re a growing, tight-knit team - and we’re just getting started 🚀 We work closely with Product, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Sales, and every level of leadership, including closely with our CEO Benji . We’re seen as strategic partners, not a service desk. PMM at Ashby means influence, visibility, and ownership - and this role is a chance to get in early on a team with strong internal momentum at a company growing fast. We value technical curiosity, editorial clarity, and first-principles thinking. We avoid jargon, favor plain English, and aim to genuinely help customers understand what our product does and how it can help them. You don’t need a decade in PMM to succeed here - but you do need strong product instincts, clear writing, and a bias for building systems that scale. We’re looking for a Release Marketer who is excited about owning product releases. This role is for someone who thrives on the details but understands the bigger picture – someone who can clearly explain how a new feature or product benefits prospects and customers in their daily workflows and approach to talent acquisition. Someone who wants to work closely with Product and Engineering to understand how a feature works, and act as a translator for the front-line teams. That means translating product specs into the materials, messaging, and demos that power our releases. This person should feel excited about selling with value and obsess over customer use cases and how we tell our product story. From crafting one-pagers and recording crisp, clear product videos and walkthroughs, to running our product updates newsletter, to building internal enablement that keeps our whole team informed on what’s changed, you’ll help us tell our differentiated story and keep our launch velocity high. You’ll work across multiple product lines, so you’ll need to context switch easily. Organization, attention to detail, and the ability to juggle and coordinate across multiple teams are among the most important skills for this role. On any given week, you’ll be keeping several releases moving, each with its own Product Manager. Because we’ve built deep relationships with a thoughtful, engaged customer base, we’re often co-creating with them - sharing product materials that are actually read, used, and appreciated by people who see us as partners, not just vendors. This is a great fit for someone who enjoys being in the weeds of technical products, but also has a sharp editorial voice, a strong eye for design, strong product instincts, and loves to always be shipping. While this role will flex across multiple products, you’ll have the opportunity to grow into eventually owning a full product line. This role is also a great opportunity for someone who wants to flex across PMM and enablement skills, and work on product marketing initiatives that create more leverage for our teams. Your Background There is not a single background that is the perfect fit for this role. We care more about the skills and intrinsic capabilities you bring to the table, and could see someone from a number of different backgrounds being a good fit, including: A Solutions Engineer who loves narrative and wants to shape more than just demos An Early-stage AE who worked closely with Product A Product-minded builder with a technical background and customer empathy A GTM specialist with a strong lean for product taste What You’ll Do Release Products and Features Own go-to-market planning and execution for feature releases across multiple product lines. Work closely with Product Managers to shape value propositions, messaging, and demo strategies. Produce polished feature videos for use across social media, the website, and other marketing channels. Create assets including blog posts, one-pagers, demo videos, internal launch docs, and enablement materials. Turn features into clear customer value through videos, product walkthroughs, and content that make the benefit obvious. Partner with other product marketers on larger and bundled launches where support is needed. Keep the release engine moving and create leverage for your team Serve as a product expert and go-to resource for how features work and how we position to the market. Coordinate release promotion with Solutions Engineering, RevOps, Sales, CS & Support teams to ensure audiences across the organization are best-equipped through their channels. Own initiatives that keep the whole team informed on product changes, including our product updates newsletter to customers. Help maintain our product launch velocity by leveraging AI, automation, and building scalable systems to manage a high volume of releases, giving yourself time back for more high-leverage work. You Might Be a Fit If You You’re highly organized, and can keep multiple releases, owners, and deadlines moving at once without anything slipping. You’ve got an exceptional eye for detail - people consistently trust you as the final eye on something because you catch more than just typos every time . You can switch between products and contexts easily, and pick up a new feature quickly enough to explain it well. You’re the person people ping and say, “Can you just explain this feature in normal words?” and you actually can. You know how to

descriptionAr: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. Senior Product Designer, Knowledge Graph This is a remote position based in the United States.  (East Coast US preferred, open to other time zones for exceptional candidates) . The Opportunity: As a Senior Product Designer at Grafana Labs, you will join a growing Product Design organization of more than 25 designers, researchers, engineers, and design leaders distributed across six continents. You will work within a 100% remote R&D organization, so strong, proactive remote communication, collaboration, facilitation, and relationship building skills will be essential to your success. As  Senior Product Designer for Grafana Cloud’s Knowledge Graph , you'll design experiences for the context layer of Grafana Cloud that powers our entity graph, entity catalog and RCA workbench. Knowledge Graph automatically discovers services, infrastructure, and databases from the telemetry teams already have, maps how they depend on each other, and runs anomaly detection. This gives engineers, SREs, and their agents an up to date picture of their systems. We want anyone to be able to understand a system and resolve an incident faster, without writing queries or maintaining alert rules, not just the one person who happens to know it best. Over time, you will develop deep expertise in your product area and associated customer and user personas, use cases, and workflows, which will enable you to design tailored, role-driven experiences. You will also have an opportunity to contribute to the evolution of the Product Design team at Grafana by coaching and mentoring other designers, collaborating on team internal initiatives, and helping evolve new ways of working, learning, and having fun together as the team scales. What You’ll Be Doing: Enabling customers to easily understand and explore how their systems connect to each other. Find clear, simple ways to show complex, constantly-changing information without overwhelming the user Translate research and data to experiences that are easy to digest and break down complexity Tailor the experience to different target audiences, covering multiple user perspectives Work cross-functionally with peers and leaders in engineering, product management, technical writing, and GTM functions, as well as other members of the Product Design team Prioritise for delivering impact while balancing business priorities, customer wishes and technical considerations  Document user needs and pain points, design directions, UX trade-offs, and detailed designs for specific features and enhancements Execute research and contribute to quantitative and qualitative research initiatives with researchers, cross-functional collaborators, customers, and members of the Grafana user community What Makes You a Great Fit: 7+ years of relevant design experience working on B2B/enterprise software products, ideally designing tools and services for developers or other highly technical users A portfolio of effective designs for complex products delivered in a fast-paced environment Experience running qualitative research in complex fields, building empathy with users and humans, their needs and pain points even when you have very little in common with them Ability to make design decisions that appropriately balance business goals, product priorities, customer feedback, research insights, and technical considerations Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams across multiple locations and time-zones to iteratively ship and evolve products while keeping the end design vision in mind Attention to detail and willingness to learn about a complex, very technical product space Experience working in a fully-remote, fast-paced environment where you are expected to share openly, default to transparency, and embrace your autonomy Bonus Points For: Experience designing complex, descriptionAr: About Ramp Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books. The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving. We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome. The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same. If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it. About the Role As a member of Ramp's Fraud Operations team, you will play a pivotal role in safeguarding the company and its customers against fraudulent activities. This position involves analyzing new account applications, monetary and non-monetary account activity to identify and mitigate risks associated with first-party and third-party fraud. We are seeking a detail-oriented professional who is adept at applying fraud detection techniques and leveraging data sources and tools to develop logical courses of action. In addition to technical acumen, this role requires strong interpersonal and communication skills to interact effectively cross-functionally and with customers, external financial institutions, and law enforcement agencies. Ideal candidates are self-starters who are energized by ambiguity and love creating clarity. What You'll Do Analyze new account applications to detect potential fraud patterns, including identity theft, synthetic identities, and other high-risk behaviors. Evaluate transactional activity, identifying anomalies and irregularities indicative of fraudulent behavior. Thoroughly investigate alerts of first-party and third-party fraud, providing comprehensive documentation of findings. Investigate and facilitate customer card disputes, ensuring cases are resolved accurately and within network timelines. Use AI tools and automation to streamline investigations, and help develop and improve the processes and tooling behind them. Collaborate with internal teams, such as Credit Risk, Compliance, and Customer Support, to ensure timely resolution of fraud-related issues. Communicate directly with customers to verify account activity, resolve disputes, and gather necessary documentation during investigations. Liaise with external stakeholders, including financial institutions and law enforcement, to support investigations and facilitate recovery efforts when necessary. Stay updated on emerging fraud trends, industry best practices, and regulatory requirements to enhance fraud prevention and detection measures. Perform root cause analyses, document control breakdowns, and work with the strategy and engineering teams to improve fraud controls. Document procedures and proactively identify opportunities for operational process improvement. Work Schedule Requirements Fraud doesn't operate on a standard 9-to-5 schedule, and neither does this role. Candidates must have the flexibility to work nights, weekends, and holidays as part of a rotating schedule to ensure 24/7 fraud monitoring and response. This is essential to maintaining Ramp’s commitment to protecting its customers and minimizing risk around the clock. What You Need Minimum 2 years of experience in fraud prevention or investigations Experience within consumer/corporate/small business cards, payments, invoices, lending, or related industries Excellent collaboration, written and verbal communication skills Nice-to-Haves Experience with NACHA rules and regulations Experience with card network rules and regulations, including dispute and chargeback processes Experience with funds recovery processes, including hold harmless letters and ACH recalls Experience in high-growth startups Experience integrating AI into your daily work
